name: Aegiomon
look: a young god-man with goat's horns and legs, white spiky hair, a red scarf, a black vest and one big white glove
entry: A young god-man with a goat's horns and legs. It hums a tune through its syrinx that makes anyone who hears it forget everything but Aegiomon, then floors them with a crackling punch.
how: Wild: uncommon in hills, plains and mountains.
Evolves into Aegiochusmon: Blue at level 35.
Evolves into Aegiochusmon: Dark at level 35.
Evolves into Aegiochusmon: Green at level 35.
Evolves into Aegiochusmon: Holy at level 35.
